text.p: Warrantech Corp said Monday it has formed a mergers and acquisitions team that would identify and pursue potential deals.
The team will be led by Bernard White, its former chief financial officer, who has been appointed to the new position of senior vice president and treasurer, it said.

Warrantech said it was looking for a new CFO. In the meantime, CFO duties will be taken by Harris Miller, currently executive vice president of corporate affairs, it said. Miller was CFO before White's appointment to the post in 1994, it said.

Warrantech administers and markets service contracts and after-market warranties on automobiles, automotive components, recreational vehicles, appliances, consumer electronics, computers and computer peripherals for retailers and distributors.
